chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah, from Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Thabit ibn Sharih, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When a man marries a woman and divorces her before consummating the marriage, there is no waiting period (iddah) upon her, and she may marry whomever she wishes from that moment, and one divorce makes her irrevocably divorced.
Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Salih ibn Khalid and Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Thabit ibn Sharih, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) – similar to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a woman divorced before consummation in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a pre-consummation divorce (talaq qabl al-dakhul) is irrevocable, allowing the woman to exit the marriage immediately without observing the waiting period (iddah). This ruling distinguishes such cases from post-consummation divorces, where the woman must wait for one menstrual cycle or pregnancy to conclude, reflecting the principle that the marital bond is not fully sealed until physical intimacy occurs. The narration is corroborated by multiple chains of transmission, including those of Humayd ibn Ziyad and Ibn Sama'a, underscoring its reliability in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abdullah, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Sabit Bin Shreyh, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When he marries a woman, so he divorces her before going to bed with her, so there is no waiting period upon her, and she can marry the one whom she so desires to, from that very moment, and the one divorce makes her to be irrevocably divorced’.

Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Salih Bin Khalid and Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Sabit in Shurayh, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Thabit ibn Shurayh from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a man marries a woman, then divorces before going to bed with her, she then does not need to count her waiting period. She can marry whomever she wants in the same hour after divorce and she becomes stranger to him by one divorce.’”
Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from Salih ibn Khalid and ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Thabit ibn Shurayh from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a similar Hadith .
